about: Phase 359’s grader fixtures (build/p359/SPEC.md §8). Every honest reading is the one reader’s own over a raw folder in raw/: the parent’s from the spec step’s parent runs, HEAD’s from its prototype runs (the design’s two hunks on the parent), each HEAD reading carrying the parent’s link (the doors its parent run booted from). HC and NR were not measured at the spec step, so their folders are constructed and say so. Every clause has a broken reading that fails it alone, and every need an unreadable one that misses it alone; raw/ holds the readings the reader must reproduce, the parent’s defect read red by HEAD’s graders, and drives that did not take read UNREADABLE. The probe review’s entries (docs/method/HOW-WE-BUILT-THIS.md rule 9) are named “REVIEW: …”: two recorded parent runs the builder did not commit (raw/rv-parent-B1-b3, raw/rv-parent-C0-b4) and broken runs planted on recorded folders by applyRawOps, each saying so.
